title: Financial Dynamics and Interconnected Risk of Liquid Restaking
abstract: arXiv:2604.03274v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decentralized finance introduces new business models and use cases as part of digital finance. Restaking has recently emerged as a transformative mechanism in DeFi, promising extra yields but introducing complex and interconnected risks. The paper monitors the current restaking landscape, empirically analyzes the revenue drivers of a liquid restaking protocol, and conducts a technical investigation on the emitted risk arising from the interconnection between liquid restaking and other protocols. The revenue dynamics of Renzo Protocol are analyzed by employing an OLS regression model, Granger-causality and random forest feature importance tests. Our results identify that revenue is primarily predicted by the value locked in the underlying EigenLayer ecosystem, the yield of Renzo protocol's liquid restaking token and the multi-blockchain expansion of that token. translated_title: 流动性质押的金融动态与互联风险
translated_abstract: 去中心化金融作为数字金融的一部分，引入了新的商业模式和用例。近年来，再质押（Restaking）作为DeFi中的一种变革性机制出现，承诺提供额外收益，但同时也引入了复杂且相互关联的风险。本文监测了当前再质押的格局，实证分析了流动性质押协议的收益驱动因素，并对流动性质押与其他协议之间互联所产生的风险进行了技术调查。通过采用OLS回归模型、格兰杰因果检验和随机森林特征重要性测试，分析了Renzo协议的收益动态。我们的结果表明，收益主要由底层EigenLayer生态系统中锁定的价值、Renzo协议流动性质押代币的收益率以及该代币的多链扩展所预测。流动性质押代币的多链扩展带来了潜在的互联风险，这需要进一步关注。
tldr: 本文通过实证分析发现，流动性质押协议的收益主要受EigenLayer锁定价值、代币收益率及多链扩展驱动，并揭示了其互联风险。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically identifies that liquid restaking protocol revenue is primarily driven by EigenLayer locked value, token yield, and multi-chain expansion, while highlighting interconnected risks.
